body.title: Listing-driven path continuity
body.summary: Switch pathContinuity to examine only commits from sources.pathChanges that descend from the origin, comparing existence on each edge whose parent is the origin or descends from it; keep the selected-origin exemption, error message and LIMITS; update the comment. Add the cost, lineage, failure and read-limit tests and keep the pinned identity.
acceptanceChecks: Selected-path file() calls, decoded bytes and pathChanges calls are equal for 4 and 40 untouched interleaved commits.
Side-branch deletion/recreation merged back still fails with scope_conflict; existing projection tests (including the rename and move-exemption tests) pass.
The pinned identity from t1 still matches.
The eedc4519199b24b4/s1 correction packet prepares without projection_limit, and starting attempt 4 of board-common-model-s1 re-prepares attempts 1-3 to their stored identities (reported smoke).

tests.name: lineage reads do not grow with interleaved commits that leave the selected path untouched
a side-branch deletion merged back with the file kept still interrupts lineage
a side-branch deletion and recreation merged back still interrupts lineage
a path history failure is a source error, not a projection limit or lineage conflict
the read limit still refuses with projection_limit when the selected file itself changed too often
projection identity matches the identity pinned from the code before the change
identical final blobs cannot hide an unselected rename-away and recreation
selected rename chains compare exact blobs independently of rename similarity and reject unselected moves
production projection budgets accept their exact ceilings and refuse the next unit
the eedc4519199b24b4/s1 correction packet prepares without projection_limit and attempt 4 re-prepares saved attempts 1-3 to their stored identities
